name: collapsible
purpose: Single disclosure: a native button (aria-expanded, aria-controls), optionally inside a heading, that shows and hides one content region, such as 'Show more details' or an advanced-settings section.
whenToUse: Optional or advanced content that most users do not need: details, advanced settings, long explanations.
One section that the user can expand on its own.
whenNotToUse: Content the user must see to complete the task (do not hide it).
Navigation menus: use Menu or Sidebar.
responsive: Full width of its container; the region height animates when the theme allows motion.
rtl: Logical properties: the icon follows the label at the inline end.
theme: Trigger color-text with color-link on hover (plain) or color-hover background (bordered); bordered uses component tokens collapsible-border-color and collapsible-radius. Focus ring color-focus-ring. Height animation uses duration-normal and easing-standard and is off for reduced motion and animation 'none'.
security: String content and the label are rendered as text; Node content is inserted as given (the application owns it).
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry.
limitations: Hidden content is not found by the browser's find in page.
The open state is not remembered across page loads (store it in the application if needed).
unsupported: Several sections with single-open behavior (use Accordion).
HTML strings as content (pass a Node).
antiPatterns: Hiding required instructions or errors in a collapsed region.
Using a collapsible as a navigation menu.
